Name: Modest Creative Warehouse Shed Redux
Author: asunai2
Description:
Modest Creative warehouse shed redux!

HmmThatVeryCURSED gets credit for redoing the code and fixing the tile sheets and redoing the basic shed in tiled for me.
Nat is the one who originally created the mod
The tile sheets belong to Dusty


Changes that I made:
Changed from tbin to TMX again, fixed up the corners in the  upgraded shed, redid walls & floors, reduced shed size to something more modest.

I loved nat's original shed but it was too big for me and was half broken in 1.5.6 so I set out to fix it with the assistance of nat and scream themselves. For the regular shed you get one room and for the delux shed you will get 3 rooms.
